entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Metal plane embroiled in war between the Mirrans and Phyrexia.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Cold, corrupting invaders of Mirrodin who cannot understand defiance and slaughter such cultures wholesale.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The defiant native peoples of Mirrodin united against Phyrexia, each race with its own battle cry.

entities.name: Goblins of Mirrodin
entities.description: Goblins who see infrared, revere the red sun as the Sky Tyrant, and recycle dead goblins' metal.

entities.name: Auriok
entities.description: Tightly-knit community of scavengers and soldiers who use names as battle cries.

entities.name: Accorders
entities.description: Roving soldiers and peacekeepers who defend Auriok communities and serve as Mirran cavalry and elite infantry.

entities.name: Vulshok
entities.description: Humans of six forge-tribes with fiery chests, led by the young Koth.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: Young leader who reminded the Vulshok of their commonalities during the war.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: The Great Furnace surrounding the red lacuna, revered by goblins.

entities.name: Sky Tyrant
entities.description: Goblin name for the red sun, believed to be the mighty hammer that forged the world.

entities.name: Razor Fields
entities.description: Region of Mirrodin where the Auriok live and loxodons communicate across wide expanses.

entities.name: The Vanishing
entities.description: Event that sowed chaos among the Vulshok forge-tribes.

entities.name: Loxodons of Mirrodin
entities.description: Confident elephantine Mirrans who remain crucial allies despite the war's atrocities.

events.summary: War rages on Mirrodin as Mirran goblin, giant and Accorder paladin charge Phyrexians with battle cries, a giant cleaving a Phyrexian exarch in two.
events.quote: is embroiled in war, and everywhere mighty cries of battle arise

events.summary: Accorders begin calling out banesaint names and the names of ranking Phyrexians to stir hatred before battle.
events.quote: Recently, Accorders have taken to calling out the names of banesaints

events.summary: The Vanishing sowed chaos among the Vulshok forge-tribes, until Koth and the war with Phyrexia reunited them.
events.quote: The Vanishing sowed chaos among the forge-tribes

events.summary: Mirrans recruit constructs, golems and Myr to the war against Phyrexia.
events.quote: Mirrans have recruited constructs, golems, Myr, and other artificial oddities to their cause

events.summary: Mirran signal pests' chirps become a signal for the start of major Mirran offensives.
events.quote: It has now become commonplace for the noises of insect-like machines to signal the start of major Mirran offensives.

relations.quote: they are what set the Mirrans apart from the cold virus of Phyrexia
all of them defended by the Accorders

relations.note: They reverently call the red sun the Sky Tyrant.
relations.quote: they reverently call it the Sky Tyrant
